tokoh_utama: A 20-year-old Indonesian male student with short messy black hair, wearing a plain grey t-shirt and dark shorts.

part.pertanyaan: Tebak, kira-kira isi aturan nomor 5 apa? Tulis di komen!
part.caption: Pindah ke kosan baru malah dapat 5 aturan aneh. Aturan nomor 5 paling bikin penasaran! #ceritahoror #kisahnyata

adegan.narasi: Di balik pintu kamar kos baruku, tertempel kertas lusuh berisi lima aturan ganjil.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a weather-beaten wooden door with a tattered paper taped to it showing handwritten numbered rules.

adegan.narasi: Anehnya, bagian aturan nomor lima sengaja disobek sampai tak terbaca sama sekali.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the tattered paper rule list where rule number five is torn off completely at the bottom.

adegan.narasi: Aturan pertama, jangan pernah jemur baju lewat maghrib kalau tak mau hilang.
adegan.gambar: A dark dim balcony of a boarding house with clotheslines swaying gently under a gloomy twilight sky.

adegan.narasi: Aturan kedua, kalau mendengar kamar mandi berisik jam 12 malam, jangan antre.
adegan.gambar: A dark hallway showing a closed bathroom door with water splashing sound light leaking underneath.

adegan.narasi: Aturan ketiga, jangan pernah menjawab jika namamu dipanggil dari arah lorong kos.
adegan.gambar: A dimly lit narrow boarding house hallway with wooden doors. One door on the left is slightly open by an inch, revealing a pale dark eye peeking intently from the crack.

adegan.narasi: Aturan keempat, lampu kamar wajib tetap menyala dan tidak boleh dimatikan total.
adegan.gambar: Interior of a small messy bedroom illuminated bright white by a fluorescent ceiling tube light.

adegan.narasi: Karena mataku sangat silau dan kipas angin membikin gerah, aku mengabaikan aturan keempat.
adegan.gambar: The young man lying on a simple mattress squinting his eyes and shielding his face from the overhead bright light.

adegan.narasi: Aku memutuskan menekan sakelar lampu untuk mematikan semua penerangan sebelum tidur nyenyak.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a hand reaching out and clicking a white plastic light switch on a dirty wall.

adegan.narasi: Kegelapan pekat langsung menyelimuti kamar kosku yang sempit dan terasa semakin dingin.
adegan.gambar: Pitch black room illuminated only by faint blue moonlight coming through small window blinds.

adegan.narasi: Suasana mendadak hening seketika, hanya menyisakan derak pelan dari kipas angin tua.
adegan.gambar: An old standing fan oscillating slowly in the dark shadows of the small bedroom.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba, suara langkah kaki berayun mendekat perlahan ke arah tempat tidurku.
adegan.gambar: Low angle view looking from the floor towards the bed in deep shadows under faint moonlight.

adegan.narasi: Begitu lampu mati, seseorang menduduki ujung kasurku hingga kasur melesak ke bawah!
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up on the corner of the mattress sinking deeply under heavy weight while a shadowy pale hands rest on the edge.

part.pertanyaan: Kalau kamu jadi aku, kamu jawab panggilan dari lorong itu nggak?
part.caption: Niatnya mau tanyain aturan nomor 5, malah dapat terror suara misterius! #ceritahoror #kisahmisteri

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan. Sosok misterius di kasurku menghilang saat aku buru-buru menyalakan lampu kembali.
adegan.gambar: The young man sitting up abruptly on his bed breathing heavily under bright fluorescent lights in fear.

adegan.narasi: Besok sorenya, aku memberanikan diri menanyakan isi aturan nomor lima ke tetangga.
adegan.gambar: The young man standing outside in the corridor talking to a male neighbour at his open door.

adegan.narasi: Sejumlah penghuni menyahut dingin, "Jangan pernah bahas aturan nomor lima lagi."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the neighbour's pale cold face looking terrified and grim as he stares back.

adegan.narasi: Mendengar pertanyaanku, semua penghuni kos langsung bungkam dan masuk kamar masing-masing.
adegan.gambar: Wide shot of the corridor as multiple room doors slam shut in unison leaving the hallway deserted.

adegan.narasi: Pintu-pintu kamar mendadak ditutup rapat tanpa ada satu pun orang yang mau menjawab.
adegan.gambar: A long empty corridor with closed wooden doors under flickering yellowish light bulbs.

adegan.narasi: Tengah malam datang, situasi kosan berubah menjadi sangat sepi dan berhawa mistis.
adegan.gambar: Nighttime in the small bedroom, shadows stretching long across the walls from a small night lamp.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba, dari lorong gelap terdengar suara wanita memanggil namaku dengan lembut sekali.
adegan.gambar: The bedroom door viewed from inside, darkness visible beneath the bottom door gap.

adegan.narasi: Suara panggilan itu sangat mirip dengan suara Bu Ratmi, sang pemilik kosan.
adegan.gambar: The young man listening intently near the door, eyes wide with anxiety and curiosity.

adegan.narasi: Bibirku sudah bersiap menjawab panggilan itu karena mengira Bu Ratmi butuh bantuan.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the young man opening his mouth slightly to reply while standing near the wooden door.

adegan.narasi: Jariku menempel pada gagang pintu, berniat membukanya sedikit untuk melihat ke luar lorong.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of a hand holding the brass door handle. In the reflection of the glass window pane beside the handle, a shadowy silhouette with elongated fingers is standing right outside.

adegan.narasi: Layar telepon genggamku mendadak menyala terang karena ada pesan masuk WhatsApp baru.
adegan.gambar: A smartphone resting on a wooden desk glowing brightly with a new chat notification banner.

adegan.narasi: Bu Ratmi yang asli mengirim chat, "Ibu lagi di kampung, jangan jawab siapa pun."
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of smartphone screen displaying a WhatsApp text message: Ibu lagi di kampung, jangan jawab siapa pun.

part.pertanyaan: Menurutmu, siapa sosok yang mengetuk pintu sambil meniru suaraku?
part.caption: Sobekan aturan nomor 5 akhirnya ketemu! Tapi yang di luar pintu itu siapa?! #ceritahoror #twistEnding

adegan.narasi: Lanjutan. Pesan dari Bu Ratmi membuat tanganku gemetaran di depan pintu kamar.
adegan.gambar: The young man backing away slowly from the door in absolute terror staring at his glowing phone screen.

adegan.narasi: Aku menjauh perlahan dari pintu dan tidak berani bersuara sedikit pun malam itu.
adegan.gambar: The young man huddling at the far corner of his bedroom pulling his knees to his chest.

adegan.narasi: Keesokan harinya, aku menyapu kolong lemari tua yang dipenuhi debu sangat tebal.
adegan.gambar: Low angle shot of a wooden broom sweeping under a heavy antique wooden wardrobe.

adegan.narasi: Sapuku tak sengaja menyenggol segulung kertas kecil lusuh yang terselip di bawah lemari.
adegan.gambar: Broom bristles pushing out a rolled torn piece of yellowed paper from under the dark wardrobe gap.

adegan.narasi: Saat kubuka, ternyata itu adalah potongan sobekan aturan nomor lima yang hilang!
adegan.gambar: Hands carefully unrolling the torn matching edge of the paper rule sheet.

adegan.narasi: Kertas itu bertuliskan pesan peringatan yang membikin seluruh bulu kudukku berdiri tegak.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of hands holding a yellowed torn paper fragment. In the background shadow cast on the wall, the shadow's head has unnaturally long neck staring directly back.

adegan.narasi: Kertas itu berbunyi, "Kalau ada yang mengetuk dan bilang dia penghuni kamar ini, jangan dibuka."
adegan.gambar: Close-up of handwriting on paper snippet showing Bahasa Indonesia warning text.

adegan.narasi: Di baris akhir tertulis penegasan mengerikan, "Penghuni kamar ini cuma kamu seorang."
adegan.gambar: Macro view of the final line of handwriting on the torn paper piece.

adegan.narasi: Jantungku berdegup kencang saat membaca tulisan yang memperingatkan bahaya nyata di kosan ini.
adegan.gambar: The young man's terrified face staring at the paper snippet with sweat drops on his forehead.

adegan.narasi: Tiba-tiba, suara ketukan pintu terdengar pelan namun tegas dari arah luar kamarku.
adegan.gambar: The solid wooden bedroom door vibrating slightly from three slow deliberate knocks from outside.

adegan.narasi: Dari balik pintu, terdengar suara bisikan yang persis sekali dengan suara diriku sendiri.
adegan.gambar: Close-up of the door frame with shadowy mist seeping under the door threshold.

adegan.narasi: Suara itu berbisik dari balik pintu, "Buka, ini kamarku."
adegan.gambar: Extreme close-up of a dark eerie pale face staring right through the peephole of the door from outside, looking identical to the main character with black lifeless eyes.
